text: Official CLI (npm-installed) to initialize agent tasks, e.g. `yylo init --task ... --subagent claude`
quote:
npm install -g @yylo/cli@0.2.2
yylo init --task "Describe one verifiable outcome" --subagent claude

text: Starting a task creates an isolated worktree from an exact base commit; preflight is read-only, finish queues the committed candidate
quote: Start hydrates an exact-base task worktree. Preflight is read-only, finish queues the committed candidate

text: `yy loop` sequentially repeats arbitrary shell commands
quote: `yy loop` repeats arbitrary shell commands sequentially.

text: Workflow contracts can be saved as reusable YAML files
quote: Save the same contract as YAML for a reusable workflow.

text: Offers a direct open-standard install path that can install a whole repository or a single slug
quote: The direct open-standard path is available now and can install the repository or one slug.

text: Runs bounded concurrent fan-out across independent kanban tasks, data items, or commands, with structured evidence captured per item
quote: Bounded concurrent fan-out for independent kanban tasks, data items, or complete commands—with structured evidence for every item.

text: Can resume a previously captured agent session by ID instead of reconstructing state from terminal scrollback
quote: Continue a captured session with `yy continue SESSION_ID`; do not reconstruct work from tmux scrollback.

text: Workflow Runner is used when a step consumes output (response, file, or session) from an earlier step
quote: Choose Workflow Runner when a step consumes `{{ steps.<id>.response }}`, a generated file, or a session from an earlier step.

text: Automatically repeats bounded iterations until no open kanban work remains
quote: Repeat bounded YYLO iterations until no open kanban work remains.

text: Imports Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and posts completed responses back to the originating thread
quote: Bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and return completed responses to their source thread.

text: CLI ledger commands to create, sort/list, and fetch individual tasks
quote:
yy ledger create "Validate recovery" --status todo --tags auth
yy ledger ready --sort asc
yy ledger get TASK_ID

text: Release channel adds ID-first Records and typed profiles for task, wiki, workflow, and artifact data
quote: The 0.2.1rc6 channel adds ID-first general Records and typed task, wiki, workflow, and artifact profiles.

text: Plans immutable experiments, runs isolated attempts, retains evaluator provenance, supports safe recovery, and produces bounded reports
quote: Plan immutable experiments, execute isolated attempts, retain evaluator provenance, recover safely, and produce bounded reports.

text: `doctor workspace` diagnoses topology problems with a nonzero exit code, without ever modifying the workspace
quote: `doctor workspace` is intentionally nonzero when it finds an actionable topology problem; it never fetches or changes the workspace.

text: A run emits a machine-readable watch receipt (state, exit code, log bytes) for CI verification
quote: A successful run prints the installed YYLO version, initializes `.juno_task/`, then emits a watch receipt with `"state":"COMPLETED"`, `"exit_code":0`, and nonzero `log_bytes`.

text: Command-line orchestrator providing repeatable workflows and receipt-backed repository changes for coding agents
quote: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes. It is for developers who want a quick agent loop and for project operators who need typed task, validation, merge, and relea

text: `task start` freezes the target commit, creates a dedicated branch/worktree, and completes dependency hydration before marking the task working
quote: `task start` freezes the protected target SHA, creates a dedicated branch/worktree, and completes configured dependency hydration before reporting `WORKING`.

text: `merge land` composes an immutable task source into a private candidate with Git ref protection, requiring recomposition if the target moves
quote: `merge land` selects one immutable task source, composes in a private detached candidate, and uses Git expected-old ref protection. A moved target requires recomposition and renewed candidate checks.
